cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got Mum's lunch visit in hand. Would you call this spoon polished, or shall I give it another pass?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You promised to clean the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A good visit starts with details. You decide on the forks; I'll trust your standard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've asked Mum to bring rubber gloves. She'll help you tackle the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, I've always favored a family effort. Pick a guest towel for her, would you? Any color you like, as long as we agree it looks welcoming.

reason: Give the confident host a cooperative detail-selection tactic that absorbs B actual cleaning solution into a new minor hospitality discussion.
